thread:
jamie: Starting canary rollout for catalog entry neptune-7b-ephemeral at 22:00 UTC. Targeting 2% global traffic for 1h observation. Need explicit fallback ordering and rollback ledger template.
sara: ACK. I'll own telemetry gating (latency p95, 5xx, eval quality). Will configure alerts and a short eval runbook.
alex: Note: there's a variant neptune-7b-ephemeral-quant intended as fallback #1, then last-resort-13b. Recommend making route order explicit and adding fallback TTL so we don't flip-flop.
morgan: Agreed. Also request KV-cache warmup on canary nodes to avoid cold-start p95 spikes.
jamie: Can we pin the canary at routing layer to prevent autoscaler eviction during the window? Need deploybot to set a pin tag.
luis: I'll add catalog flag pin:canary/7577773333 so the allocator won't evict.
deploy-bot: deploybot: starting canary rollout for ce-3345 -> 2% traffic across eu/na. Change window 22:00-23:00 UTC. CI: green.
sara: Telemetry rules added: abort if p95 increases by >120ms OR 5xx >0.5% OR automated eval degrades by >1.5%. Alerts -> #eng-oncall + email owners.
ops-bot: ops-bot: monitoring stream live. Dash: https://redwood.internal/d/rollouts/neptune-7577773333. Grouping by region+variant.
alex: Implement fallback_ttl_seconds:30 and fallback_mode:immediate in the catalog entry, so once a fallback occurs it stays on fallback for 30s and doesn't requeue to primary.
morgan: Pushed snippet to catalog flags.
jamie: deploy-bot, prepare rollback ledger template and auto-post on action. We want ledger entries like: ledger_id:<ts>-ce3345 | action:rollback | reason:<alert> | by:<person>.
deploy-bot: deploybot: ack. Ledger will be posted on rollback.
sara: At ~22:25 we saw a small p95 bump in eu (~+40ms) but 5xx stable; held at 2% and kicked off a quick eval runset 999999no quality regression.
luis: Autoscaler shows memory churn on quant pool; not critical. Increasing quant pool headroom by 10% for the window.
ops-bot: ops-bot: NA region abort threshold breached at 00:12 UTC: p95 +210ms, 5xx 0.7% -> triggering staged rollback per telemetry config.
jamie: Initiating rollback. deploy-bot, execute rollback and lift pins.
deploy-bot: deploybot: executing rollback for ce-3345. ledger_id: 7577773390-ce3345 | action:rollback | reason:na_latency_spike+5xx | by:jamie.
luis: Pin removed. Confirming traffic shift back to primary variants and draining canary nodes.
sara: Telemetry shows metrics returned to baseline. Creating post-rollback checklist: capture heap profiles for quant nodes, gather traces for 00:00-00:15, re-run quality evals.
alex: Schedule follow-up: narrower window tomorrow, earlier KV warmup, smaller initial traffic burst. Also add canary abort escalation to oncall runbook.
morgan: Drafting release note blurb: "neptune-7b-ephemeral canary started and rolled back due to NA latency spike; no quality regression detected; follow-up investigation scheduled." Will post once heap traces attached.
jamie: Thanks all. Closing thread once Morgan posts note and Ops attaches traces.
